name: AfterTech
source:
Jonas is a hacker who stumbles upon a mysterious conspiracy online. During his investigation, he finds a lone egg in the wired, a virtual expanse of online connections. This egg soon hatches, and he meets a creature who assigns itself as his new best friend!

However, unknown to both of them, Jonas isn't the only one who uncovered a digital egg that day...

[From [url=https://shoujodev.itch.io/aftertech]Itch.io[/url]]
